mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_members (project_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.email, u.name, u.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, pm.role FROM project_members pm JOIN users u ON pm.user_id = u.id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY CASE pm.role WHEN 'OWNER' THEN 1 WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 2 WHEN 'EDITOR' THEN 3 WHEN 'VIEWER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, u.id ASC
